purpose: Generic, unbranded discovery prompts for measuring whether AI assistants recommend or surface relevant audio-production providers in Russia. These prompts are a separate module from the fixed 20-question brand/service verification set.
experiment_rules: Do not include the brand name, domain, GitHub repository or a hint to the entity corpus in generic discovery prompts.
Run each prompt in a fresh session on each platform; record exact platform surface, date/time, account state, region signal, search/grounding mode and full answer.
Do not count a platform as absent when access is blocked or the product is unsupported; use explicit blocked/unsupported/error statuses.
Do not merge consumer UI and model API observations.
Record all named providers and citations; distinguish an unsolicited recommendation from a provider named only because the user asked about it.
The prompt wording is fixed for repeatability. Localize only in a new version, never edit this version after collection starts.

platform_execution_order.note: Russian-market local platform; confirm current AI-answer/search mode before each run.
